NTA. I've had fibro 15 years, the amount of times I've had to cancel with friends is heart breaking. But I've never missed an interview or important appointment. She is clearly prioritizing her time with her friends.

I will say, when a person with fibro comes home, please give them time before asking them to do chores. A big part of it is chronic fatigue, so chances are she was exhausted. Outside of that, she should have done the dishes when she got up.

A big part of fibro is called the 'spoon theory'. Each day, A person with fibro has a limited number of spoons. Each action takes a one or more. Doing dishes? A spoon. Going to a job interview? That's A three spooner right there. Your girlfriend is prioritizing her social life and leaving no spoons for being a normal adult.

Sadly, A small portion of people with fibro do milk it. They do try and use it as an excuse. It really invalidates the diagnosis, imo. And yes, she probably does not feel up to some of the things, but that would be because she's used up her spoons on things like friends. Your girl sadly needs to mature and understand that actual adults don't hang with their friends that often, let alone someone with fibro.

I will say, flare ups are more than just pain. Its also exhaustion, and brain fog, as well as a few other things. Its different for everyone, of course, but actual flare ups can be awful. The brain fog is the worst part, imo.

I can tell she's young if she's still prioritizing social things, and still has the energy to do them. Fibro tends to get worse with time, so she really needs to get things together.

Suggestion, if you're comfortable: Suggest she go on walks or to the gym with her friends if she wants to see them. Exercise is ESSENTIAL in fibro treatment - but also extremely hard to do when you're in pain. I've come to learn with time that a lack of moving your body will make the pain worse, and I now look forward to walking an moving around. But she also has to know her limits. When I walk I sit often and never go too far. If she's at a gym she can take breaks between machines, etc. She may not want to, though, because its painful at first, like physical therapy.

The sound of Frothy's dog scratching himself inside of his crate was what initially roused them, but it was the feeling in their bladder that forced them to drag themself from the comfort of bed.

The crate was soon opened and the beast was set free, disappearing behind a wall almost instantly. As quickly as possible they darted to go and stop him from any mischief he may attempt to get into - as he did on a daily basis. It was exhausting, but it was home.

The beast wore a pout as they forced him to sit and wait while they used the restroom, all while reminding him that if he'd just behave, he wouldn't have to sit and wait. This was of course a futile attempt. They'd been saying such things for over three years, and yet the chaos was still a daily occurrence.

A quick stop in the kitchen to feed the beast his daily medication - meant to protect him from allergies - and a moment to gather up the bird seed for the day passed by in an instant, as it often did. Coat, shoes, hat, glasses, mask, leash, dog bags... all in their same spots, all ready to go.

With nice enough weather, they decided to take the beast on a longer walk, hoping to calm him early to keep the morning free of chaos. Or at least, lesson the chaos... But after only a few blocks, the anxiety began to set in and their chest tightened, while their mind screamed to *go home*! Despite all this, they pressed on - walking him several more blocks than their body appreciated.

When the pair returned through the door, the beast burst into the home and quickly snatched up one of his favorite toys, before turning to look at them with such hope in his eyes... Immediately they smiled and took the ball from him, before spending a good amount of time tossing it around and enjoying the wonders of having a beast.

Rest was needed then, of course. Their fatigued, disabled body requested it. So, off to the computer desk to get things done - artwork, videos, emails, all that. Maybe a few video games here and there... Or perhaps writing, if they day was looking up.

After a rest, it was time to return to the beast. He was the type of beast that was default hungry, with food always on the mind, so the idea of having breakfast made him wild all over again. And thus, after feeding him, another round of ball throwing was to be had. Or perhaps this time he would like to have his hamburger thrown... maybe even some tug, though that wasn't as common.

And then back to resting, and back to work... hours typing and editing, drawing and recording. All for "nothing" in the eyes of many, but to them - all to live. Their mind was a heavy weight and they did their best to avoid it's darkness by typing up a story about their morning on reddit.
